औ: औ The diphthong Au or Ou, having the same sound as in Our, and considered as the fourteenth vowel of the Nāgarī alphabet.
औ ind. An interjection of, 1 Calling, (ho! hola.) 2 Of addressing, (the vocative particle oh.) 3 A particle of prohibition, and 4 Of asseveration.
औ m. (-औः) The serpent ANANTA. f. (-औः) The earth.
औ ind. The mystical prefix proper for Śūdras: see ओम्.
औक्थक: औक्थक m. (-कः) A Brahman acquainted with the Uktha portion of the Sāma Veda. E. उक्था, and ठक् aff.
औक्ष: औक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षी-क्षं) Relating to an ox, derived from one, &c. E. उक्षन्, and अण् aff.
औक्षक: औक्षक m. (-कः) A herd of oxen. E. उक्ष an ox, वुञ् aff.
औख्य: औख्य mfn. (-ख्यः-ख्या-ख्यं) Boiled or dressed in a pot. E. उखा a cauldron, a saucepan, यञ् aff.
औचित्य: औचित्य nf. (-त्यं-ती) Propriety, aptness, fitness. E. उचित proper, ष्यञ् affix in the abstract sense.
औजसिक: औजसिक m. (-कः) A hero. E. ओजस् strength, ठक् aff.
औडुपिक: औडुपिक m. (-कः) A passenger, one going in a raft or boat. E. उडुप, and ठक् aff.
औडुम्बर: औडुम्बर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) 1 Coppery, made of copper, &c. 2 Made of the wood of the Uḍumbara fig tree. m. (-रः) A name of YAMA the regent of death. n. (-रं) 1 A kind of leprosy. 2 Copper. E. उडुम्बर, and अण affix: see उडुम्बर, उदुम्बर, &c.
औड्र: औड्र m. (-ड्रः) An Uriya, an inhabitant of Urisa. E. ओड्र, and अण् aff.
औत्कर्ष्य: औत्कर्ष्य n. (-र्ष्यं) Excellence, superiority. E. उत्कर्ष, and ष्यञ् aff.
औत्तमि: औत्तमि m. (-मिः) The third MANU. E. उत्तम, and इञ् patron. aff.
औत्तरपथिक: औत्तरपथिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Going or coming in a northerly direction. E. उत्तर, पथ for पथिन् a road, ठक् aff.
औत्तानपादि: औत्तानपादि m. (-दिः) A name of DHRUVA, in mythology the son of UTTĀNAPĀDA, and grandson of the first MANU; in astronomy, the polar star, or the north pole itself. E. उत्तानपाद, and इञ् patronymic aff.
औत्पातिक: औत्पातिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Portentous, calamitous. E. उत्पात, and ठक् aff.
औत्सङ्गिक: औत्सङ्गिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Carried or placed upon the hip or flank. E. उत्सङ्ग, and ठक् aff.
औत्सर्गिक: औत्सर्गिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Omitting, leaving. 2 Terminative, completing, relating or belonging to a final ceremony, by which the rite is dismissed. 3 Natural, inherent. 4 Derivative, produced from or of, directly and naturally. E. उत्सर्ग abandoned, and ठञ् aff.
औत्सुक्य: औत्सुक्य n. (-क्यं) Anxiety, perturbation, regret. E. उत्सुक anxious, ष्यञ् aff.
औदक: औदक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Watery, aquatic, of or belonging to water. E. उदक, and ठञ् aff.
औदनिक: औदनिक m. (-कः) A cook. E. ओदन boiled rice, and ठक् aff.
औदरिक: औदरिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Selfishly voracious. E. उदर the belly, and ठक् aff.
औदश्वित: औदश्वित mfn. (-तः-ती-तं) Made of buttermilk, &c. n. (-तं) Buttermilk with an equal proportion of water. E. उदश्वित the same, and अण् affix; or with कस् added औदश्वित्क.
औदार्य: औदार्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) Magnanimity, generosity, greatness. E. उदार liberal, and ष्यञ् aff.
औदार्य्य: औदार्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) Magnanimity, generosity, greatness. E. उदार liberal, and ष्यञ् aff.
औदास्य: औदास्य n. (-ष्यं) Philosophy, stoicism, indifference. E. उदास, and ष्यञ् aff.
औद्दालक: औद्दालक n. (-कं) A bitter and acrid substance like honey, said to be found in the nest of the white ant.
औद्धत्य: औद्धत्य n. (-त्यं) Arrogance, disdain. E. उद्धत haughty, and ष्यञ् aff.
औद्धारिक: औद्धारिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Heritable, portionable, belonging to a share or portion. n. (-कं) A portion or inheritance. E. उद्धार a share, ठञ् aff.
औद्धाहिक: औद्धाहिक n. (-कं) A gift made to a woman at her marriage. E. उद्धाहिक, and अण् added.
औद्भिज्ज: औद्भिज्ज n. (-ज्जं) Fossil salt. E. उद्भिज् the same, and अण् aff.
औद्भिद: औद्भिद n. (-दं) Rock or Sambher salt. E. उद्भिद्, and अण aff.
औपकार्या: औपकार्य्या f. (-र्य्या) A booth, a residence.
औपकार्य्या: औपकार्य्या f. (-र्य्या) A booth, a residence.
औपगवक: औपगवक n. (-कं) A multitude of the descendants of Upagu. E. औपगव the patronymic of उपगु, and वुन् aggregate aff.
औपग्रस्तिक: औपग्रस्तिक m. (-कः) An eclipse, or the sun or moon in eclipse. E. उपग्रस्त an eclipse, ठक् aff.
औपग्रहिक: औपग्रहिक m. (-कः) An eclipse, or the sun or moon in eclipse. E. उपग्रह an eclipse, ठञ् aff.
औपजानुक: औपजानुक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Upon or near the knees. E. उपजानु, and ठक् aff.
औपधेय: औपधेय n. (-यं) The wheel of a carriage. E. उपधि, and ढञ् pleonasm.
औपनायनिक: औपनायनिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Relating to the rite of investiture. E. उपनयन, and ठञ् aff.
औपनिधिक: औपनिधिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Relating to a deposit. n. (-कं) A deposit, the thing pledged or deposited. E. उपनिधि, and ठक् aff.
औपनिषद: औपनिषद mfn. (-दः-दी-दं) Scriptural, theological. E. उपनिषद, and अण् aff.
औपम्य: औपम्य n. (-म्यं) Resemblance, similitude. E. उपमा, and ष्यञ् aff.
औपयिक: औपयिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Right, fit, proper. n. (-कं) A means, an expedient. E. उपाय an expedient, ठक् aff.
औपरिष्ट: औपरिष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टी-ष्टं) Being or produced above. E. उपरिष्ट, and अण् aff.
औपरोधिक: औपरोधिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Proceeding from or relating to kindness or favour. 2 Opposing, impeding, connected with or relating to a check or hindrance. E. उपरोध, and ठक् affix. m. (-कः) A staff of the wood of a particular tree, (the Pīlu.) E. उपरोध willingness to oblige, &c. ठक् aff.
औपल: औपल mfn. (-लः-ली-लं) Stony, of stone. E. उपल, and अण् aff.
औपवस्त: औपवस्त n. (-स्तं) Fasting, a fast. E. उपवस्त, and अण् aff.
औपवाह्य: औपवाह्य mfn. (-ह्यः-ह्या-ह्यं) Drawn for pleasure, (a carriage.) E. उपवह a conveyance, यञ् aff.
औपसर्गिक: औपसर्गिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Portentous. 2 Prepositive, connected with a preposition. 3 Relating to change, &c. m. (-कः) Irregular action of the humors of the body, producing cold sweats, &c. E. उपसर्ग a portent, ठक् aff.
औपस्थ्य: औपस्थ्य n. (-स्थ्यं) Cohabitation, sexual enjoyment. E. उपस्थ, and ष्यञ् aff.
औपाध्यायक: औपाध्यायक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Preceptral, of or relating to a spiritual teacher. E. उपाध्याय, and वुञ् aff.
औपानह्य: औपानह्य mfn. (-ह्यः-ह्या-ह्यं) To be tied or bound on (grass, leather, &c.) E. उपानह, and ञ्य aff.
औपासन: औपासन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Devotional, holy, connected with or belonging to worship or service. E. उपासना, and अण् aff.
औम: औम mfn. (-मः-मी-मं) Flaxen, made of flax, &c. E. उमा, and अञ् aff.
औमक: औमक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Flaxen, made of flax, &c. E. उमा, and वुञ् aff.
औमीन: औमीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Flax, (a field of, &c.) E. उमा flax, and ख aff.
औरग: औरग mfn. (-गः-गी-गं) Serpent, serpentine, relating or belonging to a snake. n. (-गं) The constellation Aśleṣā. E. उरग a snake, and अण् affix; a serpent is the regent of this constellation.
औरभ्र: औरभ्र mfn. (-भ्रः-भ्री-भ्रं) Belonging to, &c. a sheep. m. (-भ्रः) A coarse woollen blanket. n. (-भ्र) 1 Mutton, the flesh of sheep. 2 Woollen cloth. E. उरभ्र a sheep, अण् aff.
औरभ्रक: औरभ्रक n. (-कं) A flock of sheep. E. उरभ्र, and वुञ् affix of multitude.
औरभ्रिक: औरभ्रिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Relating to, produced by, &c. sheep. m. (-कः) A shepherd. E. उरभ्र a sheep, and ठञ् aff.
औरस: औरस mf. (-सः-सी) A legitimate child, i. e. by a wife of the same tribe. E. उरस् the best, and अण् affix; the best of the twelve sons; also उरस्य and औरस्य.
और्ण: और्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णी-र्णं) Woollen (cloth, &c.) E. ऊर्णा wool, अण् aff.
और्णक: और्णक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Made of wool, woollen, &c. E. ऊर्णा, and वुञ् aff.
और्द्धदेहिक: और्द्धदेहिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Obsequial, funeral. n. (-कं) Obsequies of a deceased person; whatever is given or performed on a person's decease, as burning, offering cakes, giving  alms, &c. E. ऊर्द्ध or ऊर्द्ध्व above, देह the body, and ठक् affix; hence also और्द्ध्वदेहिक.
और्द्धश्रोतसिक: और्द्धश्रोतसिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) A Śaiva or adherent of that doctrine, which gives ŚIVA the pre-eminence in the Hindu triad. E. ऊर्द्धश्रोतस् a name of ŚIVA, viz. above whom or in whose head is the river, (-श्रोतस्) (the Ganges,) and ठक् aff.
और्व: और्व्व m. (-र्व्वः) Submarine fire. E. उर्व्व a saint so named, from whose thighs sprang a being of flame, which was received by the ocean; the affix is अण्.
और्व्व: और्व्व m. (-र्व्वः) Submarine fire. E. उर्व्व a saint so named, from whose thighs sprang a being of flame, which was received by the ocean; the affix is अण्.
और्वशेय: और्व्वशेय m. (-यः) A name of the saint AGASTYA. E. उर्व्वशी the celestial courtezan, and ठक् affix; his birth being ascribed indirectly to this lady.
और्व्वशेय: और्व्वशेय m. (-यः) A name of the saint AGASTYA. E. उर्व्वशी the celestial courtezan, and ठक् affix; his birth being ascribed indirectly to this lady.
और्वानल: और्व्वानल m. (-लः) Submarine fire. E. और्व्व, and अनल fire.
और्व्वानल: और्व्वानल m. (-लः) Submarine fire. E. और्व्व, and अनल fire.
औलूक: औलूक n. (-कं) A flock of owls. E. उलूक, and अण् aff.
औलूक्य: औलूक्य m. (-क्यः) A follower of the Vaiśeṣika doctrine. E. उलूक an owl, and ष्यञ् affix, like an owl: this etymology, and perhaps the word, owes its origin probably to controversial animosity.
औलूखल: औलूखल mfn. (-लः-ली-लं) Ground or pounded in a mortar. E. उलूखल, अण् aff.
औशनस: औशनस n. (-सं) The code, &c. of UŚANAS. E. उशनस्, and अण् aff.
औशीर: औशीर mn. (-रः-रं) 1 The cow's tail used as a fan, the Chowri. 2 A stick, or, according to some, the stick which serves as a handle to the preceding. 3 A bed. 4 A seat, a chair or stool. 5 The root of a fragrant grass, (Andropogon muricatum.) E. उशीर the root of the Andropogon muricatum, अण् aff.
औषण: औषण n. (-णं) Pungency. E. उषण pepper, &c. अण affix; also उषण.
औषध: औषध n. (-धं) A medicament, a drug, any herb, mineral, &c. used in medicine. E. औषधि an annual plant, and अण् aff.
औषधि: औषधि n. (-धिः) A deciduous plant, an annual as grass, &c. E. see औषधि.
औषधीय: औषधीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Medicinal. E. औषध, and छ aff.
औषर: औषर n. (-रं) 1 Fossile salt. 2 Iron stone. E. ऊषरा desert soil, अण् affix; also with कन् added औषरक.
औषस: औषस mfn. (-सः-सी-सं) Early, matutinal. E. उषस् the dawn, अण् aff.
औषिक: औषिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Early, morning, &c. with the dawn. E. उषा, and ठक् aff.
औष्ट्र: औष्ट्र mfn. (-ष्ट्रः-ष्ट्री-ष्ट्रं) Derived from or relating to a camel. n. (-ष्ट्रं) The camel genus or species. E. उष्ट्र, and अञ् aff.
औष्ट्रक: औष्ट्रक n. (-कं) A herd of camels. E. उष्ट्र a camel, and वुञ् aff.
औष्म्य: औष्म्य n. (-ष्म्यं) Heat, warmth. E. उष्म, warm, यञ् aff. क
